thread:
Alex G: Heads-up — CycloneCorp just sent their security questionnaire. They want: KMS envelope proof, RBAC change history, and a 90-day audit-log export. Need a response by Wed EOD. Who owns what?
Priya S: I can take KMS proof + key rotation history. Do we have a canned envelope-proof export?
Sam R: I can handle audit logs. We export from ELK -> s3. Retention is 365d; slicing 90d is trivial but need tenant ID + timeframe.
Jess L: I’ll join the call if they want a walkthrough. Do they need HSM attestation or just cloud KMS lifecycle?
Marta P: They asked for FIPS-level attestation note + proof of key custody separation. Also want a redaction checklist for PII in logs.
infra-bot: Export job queued: /infra/exports/audit/4990012345-cyclone-90d. Will run on 2026-04-10T18:00Z upon confirmation.
Alex G: @infra-bot confirm when ready. @Priya S can you paste the envelope proof template? RBAC change history is stored in SCIM audit and rbac_audit table — some cleanup needed.
Priya S: Template below:
-----BEGIN SNIPPET-----
KMS envelope proof:
- key_id: redwood-prod-KMS-1
- wrapping_algorithm: RSA-OAEP-256
- envelope_checksum: sha256:abc123def456...
- rotation_history: [2024-09-12, 2025-03-06]
- attestation_doc: s3://redwood-sec-proofs/cyclone/encryption-attest.pdf
-----END SNIPPET-----
Priya S: For cryptographic proofs we can provide a signed manifest + KMS audit events. Note: we require a signed request from Cyclone to release attestation artifacts.
Sam R: RBAC history query (example):
-----BEGIN SQL-----
SELECT user, role, changed_at, changed_by
FROM rbac_audit
WHERE changed_at >= '2026-01-01'
  AND tenant='cyclonecorp';
-----END SQL-----
Sam R: We should pseudonymize user identifiers unless they explicitly authorize full IDs.
Jess L: On the security call, ask them to confirm scope: cloud KMS logs vs on-prem HSM attestation. Also whether pseudonymized principals are acceptable.
Marta P: Legal leans toward pseudonymization for user IDs. If they demand full identifiers we need an internal approval path. Also note: our SLA for ad-hoc exports is 48 hours.
Alex G: Good points. I’ll draft the email. @Priya S attach the signed-manifest template and pointer to attestation doc. @Sam R, can you make the RBAC query exportable and add masking option?
Priya S: Uploaded draft manifest to s3://redwood-drafts/cyclone/manifest-draft-v1.json :thumbsup:
Sam R: I created a masked view (masked_user_id) and flagged it for export. Job name: cyclone_rbac_masked_4990012345.
sec-bot: Reminder: external sharing of audit logs requires a DPA/legal check. Please create a ticket in #legal-requests.
Marta P: Opening DPA checklist ticket now and scheduling a pre-call review tomorrow 15:00 PT. Invitees: Alex, Priya, Sam, Jess, Cyclone security lead.
Alex G: Thanks. I’ll send calendar invite + an email with the ask list. Anything urgent I missed?
Jess L: If they ask about forwarding logs to their SIEM, we should confirm retention and redaction rules — I’ll add a slide.
Priya S: One more technical: KMS envelope proof requires the key policy to allow our export role to call Decrypt. I’ll validate and post updates here.
Sam R: ETA on audit export is ~6 hours after approval (infra job). Can bump priority if they need it faster.
Alex G: Perfect. Closing here — prepping the email and invite. Thanks everyone.
